resolved_findings.previous_limitation: Existing make-graph.py copies announced_on into synthetic article published_on. RecargaPay source publication differs from announcement; dossier, registry and note preserve this distinction. This is an owner integration concern, not changed runtime code.
resolved_findings.resolution: Existing-schema explicit articles override synthetic funding links by startup ID and source URL. Actual source publication dates survive both existing graph and SQLite builders; unknown publication dates remain empty in derived graph/SQLite and omitted from staged articles. RecargaPay retains the February event date separately from its March source publication date.

runtime_limitations.detail: Existing funding schema has one source field. Companion URLs in note and projection-map/claims preserve multi-source support, but consumers must not discard those companions. No schema expansion performed.
Existing make-graph.py creates a generic Founder edge. Modern-business scope remains in profile_facts and dossiers; consumers must not reinterpret it as original Conductor-founder evidence.

publication_disposition: Research staging reviewable. Explicit article overrides resolve the source-publication/event-date issue without shared-code changes. Existing owners retain production review and the remaining single-source/founder-scope consumer considerations.
